title: Multi-Model Machine Learning for Demand Forecasting and the Reduction of Metal Sheet Consumption in Metalworking SMEs
content: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the Peruvian metalworking sector plan production empirically, which leads to overstock, stockouts, and inefficient consumption of metal sheets. A systematic review of 97 recent studies showed that no previous solution integrates demand classification, per-product model selection, production deployment, and multi-company validation. This paper presents Predicast, a multi-tenant web platform with a ten-stage Machine Learning pipeline that combines Pareto-based product selection, ADI/CV² demand classification, feature engineering, and a Selective Algorithm Ensemble that chooses, for each product, among XGBoost, Random Forest, and Ridge through time-series cross-validation, translating 52-week forecasts into production recommendations. The system was validated with transactional data from 2021 to 2025 from four companies in the sector: the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) was 10.79% at Electro SVM, 11.30% at Metal Perú, 11.65% at CMETAL, and 15.83% at Promelsa, the only distributor, for an overall MAPE of 12.39% and an R² of 0.77. User acceptance tests with 20 users yielded a SUS score of 75.8, and all 50 functional test cases passed. At the pilot company, a retrospective evaluation estimated that Predicast would have reduced overproduction costs by up to PEN 284,606 over 2021–2025, at an operating cost of about PEN 66 per month.
